datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 according to pinned publisher dataset card.
datasets.use: Separate synthetic mobility/coordinate explorer; 10,000 trajectories and 546,273 points, no same-person clinical linkage.
limitations: Coordinate datum unspecified; do not promise actual street alignment.
606 edges across 195 trajectories imply speed above 55 m/s; derived viewer splits these edges without removing source points.
Trace road IDs do not reliably join supplied roadmap geometry IDs.
No mood, physiology, travel-mode, home labels or longitudinal person identities.
datasets.handling: CSV and text metadata safely parsed; no repository code or object deserialization executed. Originals and publisher checksums retained.

datasets.license: CC BY 4.0, verified in official repository API metadata.
datasets.use: Research-only bounded GPS/survey subset: same-study anonymous IDs and PHQ items; no integration into clinical demo or identity linking across studies.
limitations: Coordinates are rounded to 0.1 degree and collected at survey submission, not continuous walks; unsuitable for street routes or home-dwell inference.
Missing and invalid coordinates and duplicate user/time keys require explicit handling.
No exact sensor/survey timestamp matches in raw strings; offsets mostly 60 or 120 minutes. Timezone explanation is unverified, no correction or temporal join applied.
App-use files and questionnaire codebook were not downloaded; this is not the full corpus.
datasets.handling: Four plain CSV originals verified against publisher MD5 and local SHA256. No scores/classifications or inferred identity joins produced.
